description: Updates attributes (e.g., name, description, status, preferences) of an existing Trello board identified by `idBoard`.

closed.description: Set to 'true' to close (archive) the board, or 'false' to re-open.
closed.title: Closed

desc.description: New board description (max 16384 characters). An empty string removes the current description.
desc.title: Desc

idBoard.description: The ID of the Trello board to update.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idBoardSource.description: ID of an existing board to copy settings (e.g., lists, labels) from.
idBoardSource.title: Id Board Source

idOrganization.description: ID or name of the Trello Workspace to associate with this board.
idOrganization.title: Id Organization

keepFromSource.description: Comma-separated components to copy from `idBoardSource` (e.g., 'cards,labels', 'all'). Defaults to 'cards' if `idBoardSource` is set. Valid: `cards`, `lists`, `members`, `checklists`, `comments`, `labels`, `stickers`, `attachments`.
keepFromSource.title: Keep From Source

labelNames__blue.description: Custom name for the blue label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/blue'.
labelNames__blue.title: Label Names  Blue

labelNames__green.description: Custom name for the green label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/green'.
labelNames__green.title: Label Names  Green

labelNames__orange.description: Custom name for the orange label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/orange'.
labelNames__orange.title: Label Names  Orange

labelNames__purple.description: Custom name for the purple label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/purple'.
labelNames__purple.title: Label Names  Purple

labelNames__red.description: Custom name for the red label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/red'.
labelNames__red.title: Label Names  Red

labelNames__yellow.description: Custom name for the yellow label (max 16384 chars). Maps to API parameter 'labelNames/yellow'.
labelNames__yellow.title: Label Names  Yellow

name.description: New name for the board (1-16384 characters).
name.title: Name

prefs__background.description: Board background. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/background'. Use a standard Trello background name (e.g., 'blue', 'orange', 'green', 'red', 'purple', 'pink', 'lime', 'sky', 'grey') or the ID of a custom background image.
prefs__background.title: Prefs  Background

prefs__calendarFeedEnabled.description: Enable or disable the iCalendar feed. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/calendarFeedEnabled'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.
prefs__calendarFeedEnabled.title: Prefs  Calendar Feed Enabled

prefs__cardAging.description: Card aging style. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/cardAging'. Allowed values: `pirate`, `regular`.
prefs__cardAging.title: Prefs  Card Aging

prefs__cardCovers.description: Enable or disable card covers. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/cardCovers'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.
prefs__cardCovers.title: Prefs  Card Covers

prefs__comments.description: Commenting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/comments'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.
prefs__comments.title: Prefs  Comments

prefs__invitations.description: Invitation permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/invitations'. Allowed values: `admins`, `members`.
prefs__invitations.title: Prefs  Invitations

prefs__permissionLevel.description: Board visibility and permission level. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/permissionLevel'. Allowed values: `org` (Workspace-visible), `private`, `public`.
prefs__permissionLevel.title: Prefs  Permission Level

prefs__selfJoin.description: Enable or disable self-join for Workspace members. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/selfJoin'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.
prefs__selfJoin.title: Prefs  Self Join

prefs__voting.description: Voting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs/voting'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.
prefs__voting.title: Prefs  Voting

prefs_background.description: Board background. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_background'. Can be a color name, a custom background ID, or a Trello photo ID. Max length: 16384 characters.
prefs_background.title: Prefs Background

prefs_cardAging.description: Card aging style. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_cardAging'. Allowed values: `pirate`, `regular`.
prefs_cardAging.title: Prefs Card Aging

prefs_cardCovers.description: Enables or disables card covers. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_cardCovers'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.

prefs_invitations.title: Prefs Invitations

prefs_permissionLevel.description: Board's visibility and permission level. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_permissionLevel'. Allowed values: `org`, `private`, `public`.
prefs_permissionLevel.title: Prefs Permission Level

prefs_selfJoin.description: Enables or disables self-join for Workspace members. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_selfJoin'. Set to 'true' or 'false'.
prefs_selfJoin.title: Prefs Self Join

prefs_voting.description: Voting permissions. Maps to API parameter 'prefs_voting'. Allowed values: `disabled`, `members`, `observers`, `org`, `public`.
prefs_voting.title: Prefs Voting
